newsitem.title: CHINA: China begins drilling at oilfield near Hainan.
newsitem.headline: China begins drilling at oilfield near Hainan.

text.p: China's Nanhai Western Petroleum Corp has begun drilling at a new oilfield near the island of Hainan, the Xinhua news agency said on Tuesday.
It did not give a precise location for the Wei 12-1 oilfield but it said it was in the Gulf of Tonkin, or what China calls the Beibu Gulf.
It said the field covered an oil-bearing area of 14 square km and had estimated oil reserves of 35 million tonnes.
Nanhai Western planned to drill 14 wells in the field within a year, giving it annual production capacity of one million tonnes, it said without giving details.
The news agency did not say whether any foreign companies were involved in the drilling.
